description:
**TSP annealed reversal moves followed by Or-opt.** Use a complete symmetric matrix. Farthest insertion supplies the first order and its cost determines an initial positive temperature.

Generate a random reversed segment and apply simulated-annealing acceptance to the original tour costs. Cool geometrically with a positive lower limit. Keep the best visited order separately from the accepted current order.

Pass that best order to one best-improvement Or-opt scan before returning. This combines stochastic acceptance over reversals with deterministic final relocation. Annealing schedules and the finite budget are project choices.
